sentences.text:
The main allegation of the prosecution is that, on 08-09- 2015 at about 10.30 am within the limits of Kamakshipalya Police Station, that the accused persons were selling the duplicate purse and chains are illegally took stock in to the shop of M.B.Jewellers situated at P.S. Street, Chikkapet and sell the same in low price and also took the stock at situated at No.3, Mamatha Fancy Stores,
9th Cross, Agrahara Dasarahalli, Magadi Road, Bengaluru, without obtaining the valid permission/license from the copyright owner and infringed the right of the copyright of the said company and also cheated to the public and also company.

As already stated supra, the prosecution has examined 3 witnesses as PW.1 to 3 and documents got marked as Ex.P.1 & 2.
10.
The prosecution has been examined CW.7 as PW.1, he being Police Officer.

He testified before this Court that, on 08.09.2015, he himself and CW.5 deployed for patrol duty in Magadi Main Road,
mean time CW.9 called them and said that, to co-operate him to conduct raid on 'Mamatha Fancy Store'.
Accordingly , they went along CW.9 to Fancy store and found 50 chains, it contains LV seal and plastic dollar and four silver colour purse and six gold colour purse.

Further, it is relevant to note that, at the request of PW.1, further chief examination deferred on 18.08.2023.
11.
The prosecution has been examined CW.8 as PW.2.

She testified before this Court that, accused No.1 is her husband and since 2016 and running Mamatha Fancy Store at Jai Munirao Circle,
Bengaluru.

She further deposed that accused was not selling duplicate products and not cheated to the complainant's company and she does not know the contents of complaint and police did not enquired her and she did not gave any documents to the police.

This witness treated as complete hostile and Learned Senior APP with permission of the court conducted lengthy cross examination,
but nothing worth evidence has been elicited from this witness mouth to support the case of prosecution.
12. The prosecution has been examined CW.4 as PW.3.
He being owner of the shop of accused NO.1.
He testified before this Court that, he did not seen accused No.1, the accused No.1 since 2015 more than one and half year took his house for rent.
Therefore, he knew accused No.1.
he does not know anything about this case.
the Police Officers have not enquired him.

This witness treated as complete hostile and Learned Senior APP with permission of the court conducted lengthy cross examination, but nothing worth evidence has been elicited from this witness mouth to support the case of prosecution.

13. On perusal of oral and documentary evidence placed by the prosecution it appears that, the informant has lodged FIS on 8/9/2015 stating that he has been authorized to initiate proceedings and conduct criminal action before the relevant police on related Louis Vuitton products and his copyright.

Further he stated in his FIS that on 8/9/2015 at about 10.30 am during his survey it has been noticed that Mamatha Fancy Store, No.3, 9th Cross, Agrahara Dasarahalli, Near Sri.Anjineya temple, Bengaluru - 79, was selling duplicate products i.e. Louis Vuitton and causing loss to the company.
Therefore, he lodged FIS before Station House Officer of Kamakshipalya police station for infringement of copyright of his company and caused loss to his company.

Accordingly, this case is registered against the Mamatha Fancy stores shop No.3, 9th Cross, Agrahara Dasarahalli, Near Police Station vs A2, Mahendra Kumar B on 14 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/160697106/
3 Sri.Anjineya temple, Bengaluru - 79.

sentences.text: After registration of FIR CW.9 and 2 panchas and other police officers i.e. CW.1 to 7 have proceeded to the place of alleged incident and conduced raid in their presence and seized some Louis Vittion products in the shop of accused.
After thorough investigation by Investigation Officer he has charge sheeted against the accused No.1 and 2 for the offence punishable u/Sec.51(A) and 63 of copyright act.

So in order to bring home the guilt of accused No.1 and 2, the prosecution has cited CW.1 to 9, out of which the prosecution able to examined three witnesses as PW.1 to 3 and got marked Ex.P.1 & 2 by the prosecution. Despite took coercive steps against CW.1 to 4, 5, 6 & 9 the prosecution has been failed to secured their presence and failed to publish proclamation therefore, this Court took prayer of learned Sr.APP rejected and CW.1 to 4, 5, 6& 9 are dropped out vide order dated 27/11/2023, 20.02.2024 & 19.03.20024.
On perusal of oral evidence of PW.3 he being owner of said shop.
He clearly stated that, the accused No.1 is a tenant under him since 2015.
But he specifically stated he has no knowledge about this case and police officers have not get any statement of this witness.
Further on perusal of oral evidence of PW.2 it appears that, she being wife of accused No.1.
She clearly admitted in her chief-examination since 2016 they running shop at Jayamunirao Circle, A G Dasarahalli, in the name of Mamatha Fancy Stores.
But she has not stated about FIS given by CW.1 and she specifically stated that, the police officers have not enquired her and she has not produced any documents before police officers.

Further it is relevant to note that, PW.1 partly examined by prosecution and at the request of PW.1,
further chief examination of PW.1 deferred on 18.08.2023.

Despite took coercive steps against PW.1,
the prosecution has failed to secure his presence before this court well intime.
Therefore, this court took prayer of Learned Senior APP rejected and evidence of PW.1 taken as discarded as not tender for further chief examination vide order dated 20.02.2024.
So, as per the record, there is no evidence of PW.1 and PW.2 & 3 are completely turned hostile to the case of prosecution.

So from the evidence of PW. 2 & 3 it appears that, CW.9 and his staff and 2 independent panchas are proceeded and found L V products in the accused shop and seized by drawn seizure panchanama in the presence of CW.1 to 3 and other police officers by CW.9.
But CW.1 to 3 are not yet stepped into witness box.
CW.1 being authorized person to lodge complaint and take action against the violaters.
But prosecution has not examined him and CW.2 and 3 are 2 independent witnesses to seizure panchanama.
But they are also not examined by the prosecution.
So its creates serious doubt regarding the evidence of prosecution.
So from the evidence of PW.2 & 3 there is no incriminating evidence against the accused No. 2.
Non-examination of material witnesses is fatal to the case of prosecution.
The oral evidence of PW.2 & 3 have not supported the case of prosecution, they totally turned hostile to the case of prosecution, so its creates serious doubt regarding the version of prosecution.
Therefore, the prosecution has failed to prove the guilt of the accused No.2 beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the negative.
14. Point No.2 :

For the aforesaid reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER
Acting under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., accused No.2 is hereby acquitted of the offences punishable u/Sec.51(A), 63 of Copyright Act and Sec.420 of IPC.
The bail bond and surety bond executed by accused No.2 shall continue for a period of two months from the date of this order and thereafter same shall stands cancelled automatically.
